reply_text:
I saved Hollis's note and replied to him in his DM: from now on, his dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups is Gate 40.

The note is filed under his name in gbrain, marked as private and sourced to his DM. Because it came from his DM, it won't be repeated in channels or in conversations with other members. I can't confirm that gbrain actually enforces the "private" setting, though: the save went through, but the tool's description doesn't list "private" as an allowed option.
